title: Keep task command argument checks at exit status 1
text: The CLI uses one exit table: 0 applied, 1 failed while running, 2 nothing was done, 3 a followed turn was stopped. The task commands decide between 1 and 2 with a flag set partway through their own validation, so the same kind of mistake exits 1 or 2 by accident, depending on whether the check runs before or after that point. Make it follow one rule. In the task commands, only arguments that the option parser rejects exit 2. A value a task command rejects after reading its arguments, such as an unsupported --usage-scope value for usage refresh, or --pages given together with --json for task show, exits 1 and sends no command to the controller. The thread commands and print mode keep status 2 for their own checks and refusals. Update the README exit table to say so.

checks.name: cli-main
args: --test-name-pattern=CLI lists traverse empty pages and preserve incomplete output

verification.method: The checks ran in a clean export of the base commit with the hidden files from the solution commit in place, and had to fail. They then ran in a clean export of the solution commit, and had to pass. Installed dependencies were linked from the checkout.
